Weston Cage.b:
Weston Coppola Cage is an actor, recording artist, composer, writer, producer and a mixed martial artist. He has starred and Co-starred in movies such as, Assault On VA-33, Boneyard, D-Day, 211, Get Gone and Mojave Diamonds as well as appearing on NCIS Los Angeles. He has done soundtrack work on major films, Drive angry, Dog Eat Dog, Ghost Rider (voice work) and has released his album single, The Wolf. His father is Nicolas Cage. His great uncle is Francis Ford Coppola. Weston is married to Jenifer Coppola Cage. Weston Coppola Cage won Best New Artist Award with his new musical project called Wes Cage and has consistently remained a prolific actor and musician. Weston is assigned to many more leading and starring roles with a new magnum opus album that is forthcoming.

Born: December 26, 1990, Los Angeles, California, USA. Birth name: Weston Coppola Cage. Nickname: Wes. Height: 6' 2" (1.88 m).
